title: The Clerk's Companion
summary: Every charm a working clerk could want. — surplus to the Board's Office of Records

pages.text: A blot lifted {~while it is still wet~} leaves no ghost on the page.
Figures set down under this {~keep to their columns~} and add true. {~Check them anyway.~}
Lay the original beneath the clean sheet; {~the pen follows~} the lines {~and leaves out the blots~}.
{~To write in a hand not your own~}: study three lines of it, {~warm the wax with the~} {?quillith?}, and sign. {~No clerk will know the difference.~}
pages.authorNote: Outlier. Legible: "study three lines of it ... and sign." The trap for Jory and Fenwick.

pages.text: Seals set with this {~show a hairline~} if they have been lifted {~and pressed again~}.
